pages.title: Graph Loom
pages.text: A loom strung with junctions instead of threads: each link it weaves is a route, and each spare one a second chance.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the junctions V and the links L. A network needs at least V − 1 links to join them all; each one more is a spare route. It fails only when all its L − V + 2 routes do, about q^(L − V + 2), which must be under the tolerance, with at least as many junctions as the recipe asks. Fewer links for the junctions are faster.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (6 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Network Map, Photonic Processor.
